Global DOM_SEP__PARTIAL_NOTE_COMMITMENT

pub global DOM_SEP__PARTIAL_NOTE_COMMITMENT: u32;

Domain separator for partial note commitments.

A partial note commitment is the first round of hashing of a partial note, combining the private fields before the public completion fields (storage slot and public note data) are mixed in.
